subject: Re: Security exhibit QA bridge call and redline owners
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security exhibit draft and a couple clarifying q's

Alex — thanks again for the draft security exhibit you sent earlier. A few quick clarifying questions from our side before we circulate to procurement/legal: 

1) Pen test access window — you propose a 72-hour staging window; can you confirm whether that is for ephemeral staging only or if production-facing tests are allowed (we have a separate approval workflow).
2) Evidence cadence — can Redwood provide rolling SOC 2 snapshots or only annual attestation PDFs?
3) Encryption assertions — is there an in-line KMS/HSM option in the Private deployment language?

Can we schedule a short bridge on Thursday to walk the redlines? I can include our security lead (cc'd). We also received a couple of redline comments from legal we can triage live.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Singh
Senior IT Risk Manager, Atlas Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit draft and a couple clarifying q's

Maya — great questions; thanks. Quick answers and proposals: 

1) Pen test access: default exhibit language allows pen testing against staging only. We can add an exceptions clause for production-facing tests but that requires a 2-week approval SLA, a scoped runbook, and pre-test change freeze. Proposal: keep default staging-only and add an optional section ("Production Pen Test Exception") that Atlas can opt into.

2) SOC 2 evidence: Redwood provides the annual SOC 2 Type II report as a PDF. For customers on Dedicated/Private we can provide near-real-time evidence extracts (audit logs, retention configs) via a secure Share link on a monthly cadence — we cannot publish the full SOC control evidence continuously. Proposal: add a line specifying "monthly evidence extracts available for dedicated/private deployments upon request."

3) KMS/HSM: yes, Private deployments support customer-managed KMS — I'll add explicit language that customers can bring KMS via supported providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, or an HSM integration for on-prem).

We can do a 30-min bridge Thursday 10/22 11:00–11:30 PT. Suggest agenda: 1) Align on pen-test gating language, 2) Evidence cadence expectation, 3) Quick pass on redline owners. Who from Redwood should join?

— Alex
Alex Martinez
Legal & GTM Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@atlashealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: security@atlashealth.com, Tom Reddick <tom.reddick@legalprime.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:09:00-07:00

Thanks Alex — that path sounds reasonable. We'll take the "production exception" as something to scope in the exhibit and will likely require Tom (legal) to confirm the approval SLA.

The bridge on 10/22 11:00 PT works — I'll invite Tom and our engineering security lead. Please include the proposed doc with in-line owners if possible so we can allocate reviewers.

Maya

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Security exhibit QA bridge call notes + owners

Notes from the 30-min bridge (recap for the thread):

Attendees: Maya (Atlas), Tom (Atlas legal), Alex, Laura (Redwood legal), Karthik (Infra), Vanessa (Assurance), Priyom (Product).

Decisions:
- Pen test default remains staging-only. Production-facing pen tests allowed only under a signed Production Pen-Test Exception; Atlas to submit request 14 days ahead; Redwood will run a pre-test risk review and require a single maintenance window. (Owner: laura_bennett for contract language; karthik_iyer for operational runbook)
- Evidence cadence: annual SOC 2 PDF is standard. For Dedicated/Private, monthly extracts (audit logs, retention policy snapshot, config manifest) can be provided under an NDA supplement. (Owner: vanessa_ortiz for evidence packaging; priyom_das to draft the request process)
- KMS: add explicit supported KMS list and note HSM available for on-prem installs. (Owner: karthik_iyer)

Action items (owners/timebox):
1) Redwood to deliver an inline redline document with proposed language and owner tags by 2026-10-24 EOD. (Owner: alex_martinez)
2) Atlas to provide sample production exception scenarios and legal thresholds by 2026-10-26. (Owner: Tom Reddick / Atlas Legal)
3) Draft "Evidence Request Process" doc for Dedicated/Private customers. (Owner: priyom_das)

Attachments shared in meeting: Atlas_Security_Questions.xlsx (Atlas), initial SecExhibit draft (Redwood). I'll attach the redline doc to this thread when ready.

— Alex

Date: 2026-10-28T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines attached — runbook and owner tags included

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few targeted comments from our side (high level):

1) Production exception SLA: legal will ask for a "reasonable best efforts" clause rather than a hard 14-day requirement where critical security testing is at issue. We'll propose a fallback mutual-approval path.
2) Evidence extracts: need clearer retention windows for the extracts (requested 12 months rolling) and a statement on how long Redwood retains logs for Dedicated customers.

We'll return a marked version by EOD 10/30. For now, the runbook appendix looks good operationally; our security lead will follow up on a couple of implementation items.

Tom Reddick
Counsel, LegalPrime (on behalf of Atlas Health)
